lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-intensity circular clusters is visible on the mid-lateral flank, organized into roughly linear horizontal rows with approximately 4-5 spots visible per vertical column posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance are visible between the fifth gill slit and the first dorsal fin, intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a checkerboard-like structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three longitudinal structural ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8-10 distinct high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated toward the posterior trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots, significantly smaller and more densely packed than those on the lateral flank.
